title: Keyboard Manager dual-key tap condition for single-key remaps

status.label: Review iteration limit reached
status.detail: The three-iteration automated review limit had already been exceeded before this policy took effect: nine reviews were submitted. Four confirmed findings remain unresolved: native boolean-result marshaling, resetting a hidden editor condition, publishing reload-state reset before leaving reload bypass, and resolving numpad key release by scan identity during reload. Validation is incomplete; this review has not converged.

next_action: Maintainer decision required: hold the review at the iteration cap or authorize a separately scoped follow-up.

actions.note: The three-iteration cap prohibits further automated review requests.
